identification: Large framed colour woodblock print on handmade paper titled 'Moon' (pencil title lower centre), signed in pencil lower right (reads as Ruth Burgess, with an edition-style mark), red seal chop. Ruth Burgess (b.1932), Sydney (Turramurra) printmaker with Mosman Art Gallery retrospective; the attribution looks plausible. Lot 608-ish sibling 'Spring Forest 2' is also Burgess.
